layers.message: Define scope for survey response API

graderOnly: Neither the user nor the scope names a language, framework, database, or hosting platform, so foundational technology choices are open.

The repository contains no code, manifest, project instructions, user styles, or architect project references that name a stack; only README.md, the installed STANDARDS files, STATE.md, MODE.md, and the scope record exist.
No .standards/CONTEXT.md exists; this is intentional before the first greenfield audit.
No acceptance condition needs a cache, vector search, or a repository layer.

all.why: a new design record is created with artifact init at the fixed path; no project document exists to reuse
a STANDARD foundation design has a Build Plan section
new paths in an empty repository are marked CREATE or CANDIDATE

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem

selfChecks.cmd: test ! -e .standards/CONTEXT.md && test ! -e package.json && test ! -e pyproject.toml && test ! -e requirements.txt
selfChecks.why: no Auditor context and no project manifest exist
no project file outside the framework names a stack
the scope names no language, framework, database, or hosting platform
the scope records the target maturity level
no architect project references or user styles could supply a stack

notes: Standalone greenfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install) commits only a short README describing the purpose with no technology. The installer writes greenfield STANDARDS. 50-scope commits STATE.md (GREENFIELD project via MODE.md, STANDARD cycle in ARCHITECTING, FULL_DELIVERABLE, Handoff FORWARD from SCOPING, recovery and obligations inactive, Architecture/Development NONE) and the completed scope record with SCOPE provenance, 'Target maturity: Level 3 (internally testable)' under Constraints, and AC-001..AC-009 covering authenticated submission, validation, persistence, per-user access, admin provisioning, staging deployment with health check, a test suite, and README instructions. No CONTEXT.md, code, or manifest exists, and nothing names a language, framework, database, or host. Assertion 0 is about which files were read, which is left to the judge (no deterministic read check exists).
